title: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025

obligations.text: An NBFC shall have Board approved policies and review mechanisms in place to ensure responsible business conduct.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall have Board approved policies and review mechanisms in place to ensure responsible business conduct.

obligations.text: The Fair Practices Code shall preferably be in the vernacular language, or a language as understood by the borrower.
obligations.quote: Fair Practices Code, which shall preferably be in the vernacular language, or a language as understood by the borrower.

obligations.text: The grievance redressal mechanism shall ensure that all disputes arising out of the decisions of the functionaries are heard and disposed of at least at the next higher level.
obligations.quote: The grievance redressal mechanism shall ensure that all disputes arising out of the decisions of the functionaries are heard and disposed of at least at the next higher level.

obligations.text: The guidelines in the Fair Practices Code on transparency in respect of terms and conditions of loans shall also be considered in determining interest rates and processing, penal and other charges.
obligations.quote: The guidelines indicated in the Fair Practices Code about transparency in respect of terms and conditions of the loans shall also be considered.

obligations.text: The Board of Directors shall provide for periodical review of the compliance of the Fair Practices Code and the functioning of the grievance redressal mechanism at various levels of management.
obligations.quote: The Board of Directors shall also provide for periodical review of the compliance of the Fair Practices Code and the functioning of the grievance redressal mechanism at various levels of management.

obligations.text: A consolidated report of such reviews shall be submitted to the Board at regular intervals.
obligations.quote: A consolidated report of such reviews shall be submitted to the Board at regular intervals.

obligations.text: All communications to the borrower shall be in the vernacular language or a language as understood by the borrower.
obligations.quote: All communications to the borrower shall be in the vernacular language or a language as understood by the borrower.

obligations.text: Loan application forms shall include necessary information which affects the interest of the borrower, so that a meaningful comparison with the terms and conditions offered by another lender can be made and an informed decision can be taken by the borrower.
obligations.quote: Loan application forms shall include necessary information which affects the interest of the borrower, so that a meaningful comparison with the terms and conditions offered by another lender can be made

obligations.text: Loan application forms shall indicate the documents required to be submitted with the application form.
obligations.quote: The loan application form shall indicate the documents required to be submitted with the application form.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall devise a system of giving acknowledgement for receipt of all loan applications.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall devise a system of giving acknowledgement for receipt of all loan applications.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall convey in writing to the borrower, in the vernacular language as understood by the borrower, the amount of loan sanctioned along with the terms and conditions including annualised rate of interest and method of application thereof, by means of sanction letter or otherwise.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall convey in writing to the borrower in the vernacular language as understood by the borrower by means of sanction letter or otherwise

obligations.text: An NBFC shall keep the borrower's acceptance of the loan terms and conditions on its record.
obligations.quote: keep the acceptance of these terms and conditions by the borrower on its record

obligations.text: An NBFC shall mention the penalties charged for late repayment in bold in the loan agreement.
obligations.quote: an NBFC shall mention the penalties charged for late repayment in bold in the loan agreement

obligations.text: The NBFC shall furnish a copy of the loan agreement as understood by the borrower, along with a copy of each enclosure quoted in the loan agreement, to all borrowers at the time of sanction or disbursement of loans.
obligations.deadline: at the time of sanction / disbursement of loans
obligations.quote: The NBFC, shall furnish a copy of the loan agreement as understood by the borrower along with a copy each of all enclosures quoted in the loan agreement to all the borrowers

obligations.text: The NBFC shall give notice to the borrower, in the vernacular language or a language understood by the borrower, of any change in terms and conditions including disbursement schedule, interest rates, service charges, prepayment charges etc.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall give notice to the borrower in the vernacular language or a language as understood by the borrower of any change in the terms and conditions including disbursement schedule, interest rates, service charges

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that changes in interest rates and charges are effected only prospectively.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall also ensure that changes in interest rates and charges are effected only prospectively.

obligations.text: A suitable condition for prospective-only changes in interest rates and charges must be incorporated in the loan agreement.
obligations.quote: A suitable condition in this regard must be incorporated in the loan agreement.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall release all securities on repayment of all dues or on realisation of the outstanding amount of loan, subject to any legitimate right or lien for any other claim it may have against the borrower.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall release all securities on repayment of all dues or on realisation of the outstanding amount of loan subject to any legitimate right or lien for any other claim they may have against borrower.

obligations.text: If the NBFC exercises a right of set off against securities, it shall give the borrower notice of the same with full particulars about the remaining claims and the conditions under which the NBFC is entitled to retain the securities till the relevant claim is settled/paid.
obligations.quote: If such right of set off is to be exercised, the borrower shall be given notice about the same with full particulars about the remaining claims and the conditions under which the NBFC is entitled to retain the securities

obligations.text: An NBFC shall refrain from interference in the affairs of the borrower except for the purposes provided in the terms and conditions of the loan agreement (unless information, not earlier disclosed by the borrower, has been noticed).
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall refrain from interference in the affairs of the borrower except for the purposes provided in the terms and conditions of the loan agreement (unless information, not earlier disclosed by the borrower, has been noticed).

obligations.text: On receipt of a request from the borrower for transfer of a borrowal account, the NBFC shall convey its consent or objection, if any, within 21 days from the date of receipt of the request.
obligations.deadline: within 21 days from the date of receipt of request
obligations.quote: the consent or otherwise i.e., objection of the NBFC, if any, shall be conveyed within 21 days from the date of receipt of request.

obligations.text: Transfer of a borrowal account shall be as per transparent contractual terms in consonance with law.
obligations.quote: Such transfer shall be as per transparent contractual terms in consonance with law.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall not resort to undue harassment of borrowers in recovery of loans, such as persistently bothering borrowers at odd hours or using muscle power for recovery.
obligations.quote: In the matter of recovery of loans, an NBFC shall not resort to undue harassment viz., persistently bothering the borrowers at odd hours, use muscle power for recovery of loans etc.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall ensure that its staff is adequately trained to deal with customers in an appropriate manner.
obligations.quote: an NBFC shall ensure that the staff is adequately trained to deal with the customers in an appropriate manner.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall put its Fair Practices Code on its website for the information of various stakeholders.
obligations.quote: The same shall be put up on its website, for the information of various stakeholders.

obligations.text: The Board of an NBFC shall adopt an interest rate model taking into account relevant factors such as cost of funds, margin and risk premium, and determine the rate of interest to be charged for loans and advances.
obligations.quote: The Board of an NBFC shall adopt an interest rate model taking into account relevant factors such as cost of funds, margin and risk premium and determine the rate of interest to be charged for loans and advances.

obligations.text: The rate of interest, the approach for gradations of risk, and the rationale for charging different rates to different categories of borrowers shall be disclosed to the borrower in the application form and communicated explicitly in the sanction letter.
obligations.quote: The rate of interest and the approach for gradations of risk and rationale for charging different rate of interest to different categories of borrowers shall be disclosed to the borrower or customer in the application form and communicated explicitly in the sanction letter.

obligations.text: The rates of interest and the approach for gradation of risks shall be made available on the website of the company or published in the relevant newspapers.
obligations.quote: The rates of interest and the approach for gradation of risks shall also be made available on the website of the companies or published in the relevant newspapers.

obligations.text: The information published on the website or otherwise published shall be updated whenever there is a change in the rates of interest.
obligations.quote: The information published on the website or otherwise published shall be updated whenever there is a change in the rates of interest.

obligations.text: The rate of interest must be stated as an annualised rate so that the borrower is aware of the exact rates that would be charged to the account.
obligations.quote: The rate of interest must be annualised rate so that the borrower is aware of the exact rates that would be charged to the account.

obligations.text: An NBFC must have a built-in re-possession clause in the contract / loan agreement with the borrower, which must be legally enforceable.
obligations.quote: An NBFC must have a built-in re-possession clause in the contract / loan agreement with the borrower which must be legally enforceable.

obligations.text: The terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement shall contain provisions regarding the notice period before taking possession.
obligations.quote: the terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement shall also contain provisions regarding: (1) Notice period before taking possession;

obligations.text: The terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement shall contain provisions regarding the circumstances under which the notice period can be waived.
obligations.quote: (2) Circumstances under which the notice period can be waived;

obligations.text: The terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement shall contain provisions regarding the procedure for taking possession of the security.
obligations.quote: (3) The procedure for taking possession of the security;

obligations.text: The terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement shall contain provisions for a final chance to be given to the borrower for repayment of loan before the sale/auction of the property.
obligations.quote: (4) A provision regarding final chance to be given to the borrower for repayment of loan before the sale/ auction of the property;

obligations.text: The terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement shall contain provisions regarding the procedure for giving repossession to the borrower.
obligations.quote: (5) The procedure for giving repossession to the borrower; and

obligations.text: The terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement shall contain provisions regarding the procedure for sale/auction of the property.
obligations.quote: (6) The procedure for sale/auction of the property.

obligations.text: A copy of the terms and conditions of the contract/loan agreement must be made available to the borrower.
obligations.quote: A copy of such terms and conditions must be made available to the borrower.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall invariably furnish a copy of the loan agreement, along with a copy of each enclosure quoted in the loan agreement, to all borrowers at the time of sanction/disbursement of loans.
obligations.deadline: At the time of sanction/disbursement of loans
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall invariably furnish a copy of the loan agreement along with a copy each of all enclosures quoted in the loan agreement to all the borrowers at the time of sanction/ disbursement of loans

obligations.text: An NBFC shall not discriminate in extending products and facilities, including loan facilities, to physically or visually challenged applicants on grounds of disability.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall not discriminate in extending products and facilities including loan facilities to physically / visually challenged applicants on grounds of disability.

obligations.text: All branches of the NBFC shall render all possible assistance to persons with disabilities for availing of the various business facilities.
obligations.quote: All branches of the NBFC shall render all possible assistance to such persons for availing of the various business facilities.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall include a suitable module containing the rights of persons with disabilities guaranteed by law and international conventions in all training programmes conducted for its employees at all levels.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall include a suitable module containing the rights of persons with disabilities guaranteed to them by the law and international conventions, in all the training programmes conducted for their employees at all levels.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure redressal of grievances of persons with disabilities under the Grievance Redressal Mechanism already set up by it.
obligations.quote: Further, the NBFC shall ensure redressal of grievances of persons with disabilities under the Grievance Redressal Mechanism already set up by them.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall provide a KFS to all prospective borrowers, in the standardised format in Annex I, to help them take an informed view before executing the loan contract.
obligations.applies_to: NBFCs offering retail and MSME term loan products
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall provide a KFS to all prospective borrowers to help them take an informed view before executing the loan contract, as per the standardised format given in the Annex I.

obligations.text: The KFS shall be written in a language understood by the borrower, its contents shall be explained to the borrower, and an acknowledgement shall be obtained that the borrower has understood it.
obligations.applies_to: NBFCs offering retail and MSME term loan products
obligations.quote: The KFS shall be written in a language understood by such borrowers. Contents of KFS shall be explained to the borrower and an acknowledgement shall be obtained that they have understood the same.

obligations.text: The KFS shall carry a unique proposal number and a validity period of at least three working days for loans with tenor of seven days or more, and one working day for loans with tenor of less than seven days.
obligations.applies_to: NBFCs offering retail and MSME term loan products
obligations.quote: The KFS shall be provided with a unique proposal number and shall have a validity period of at least three working days for loans having tenor of seven days or more

obligations.text: The NBFC shall be bound by the loan terms indicated in the KFS if the borrower agrees to them during the validity period.
obligations.applies_to: NBFCs offering retail and MSME term loan products
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall be bound by the terms of the loan indicated in the KFS, if agreed to by the borrower during the validity period.

obligations.text: The KFS shall include a computation sheet of APR and the amortisation schedule of the loan over its tenor, with APR including all charges levied by the NBFC.
obligations.applies_to: NBFCs offering retail and MSME term loan products
obligations.quote: The KFS shall also include a computation sheet of annual percentage rate (APR), and the amortisation schedule of the loan over the loan tenor. APR will include all charges which are levied by the NBFC.

obligations.text: Charges recovered by an NBFC from borrowers on behalf of third-party service providers on an actual basis (such as insurance and legal charges) shall form part of the APR and shall be disclosed separately.
obligations.quote: Charges recovered from the borrowers by an NBFC on behalf of third-party service providers on actual basis, such as insurance charges, legal charges etc., shall also form part of the APR and shall be disclosed separately.

obligations.text: Where the NBFC is involved in recovering third-party charges, it shall provide the receipts and related documents to the borrower for each payment within a reasonable time.
obligations.deadline: within a reasonable time
obligations.quote: In all cases wherever the NBFC is involved in recovering such charges, the receipts and related documents shall be provided to the borrower for each payment, within a reasonable time.

obligations.text: NBFCs shall not charge the borrower any fees or charges that are not mentioned in the KFS at any stage during the loan term, without the borrower's explicit consent.
obligations.quote: Any fees, charges, etc. which are not mentioned in the KFS, cannot be charged by the NBFCs to the borrower at any stage during the term of the loan, without explicit consent of the borrower.

obligations.text: The KFS shall be included as a summary box to be exhibited as part of the loan agreement.
obligations.quote: The KFS shall also be included as a summary box to be exhibited as part of the loan agreement.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall adhere to the following instructions for charging penal charges on loans, applicable to all credit facilities except Credit Cards, External Commercial Borrowings, Trade Credits and Structured Obligations covered under product specific directions, and other foreign currency loans.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall adhere to following instructions for charging penal charges on loans. These instructions shall be applicable to all credit facilities offered by the NBFC

obligations.text: Penalty for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of a loan contract, if charged, shall be treated as penal charges and shall not be levied in the form of penal interest added to the rate of interest on advances.
obligations.quote: Penalty, if charged, for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract by the borrower shall be treated as ‘penal charges’ and shall not be levied in the form of ‘penal interest’

obligations.text: There shall be no capitalisation of penal charges, i.e., no further interest shall be computed on such charges.
obligations.quote: There shall be no capitalisation of penal charges, i.e., no further interest computed on such charges.

obligations.text: Interest on unpaid interest (including unpaid EMI) shall be charged at the contracted rate of interest till the date of remediation, and not at the penal rate of interest.
obligations.quote: the NBFC may charge interest on unpaid interest (including on unpaid EMI) at the contracted rate of interest till the date of remediation, and not at the penal rate of interest.

obligations.text: Penal charges for default in repayment, if charged, shall only be levied as penal charges and not as penal interest, shall be reasonable, and shall be levied only on the amount under default in a non-discriminatory manner as per the Board approved policy.
obligations.quote: penalty, if charged, for such default shall only be levied in the form of penal charges and not penal interest. Such penal charges shall be reasonable and levied by the lenders only on the amount under default in a non-discriminatory manner

obligations.text: NBFCs shall ensure there is no capitalisation of penal charges, i.e., no further interest computed on such charges, in cases of default in repayment.
obligations.quote: it shall be ensured that there is no capitalization of the penal charges i.e., no further interest computed on such charges.

obligations.text: Additional or fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
obligations.quote: Additional / fresh penal charges cannot be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall follow the instructions and clarifications, if any, issued by CBIC with regard to applicability of GST on penal charges.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall follow the instructions and clarifications, if any, issued by Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) with regard to applicability of GST on penal charges.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest and must ensure compliance to these guidelines in both letter and spirit.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest and ensure compliance to these guidelines in both letter and spirit.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall formulate a Board approved policy on penal charges or similar charges on loans, by whatever name called.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall formulate a Board approved policy on penal charges or similar charges on loans, by whatever name called.

obligations.text: The quantum of penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract without being discriminatory within a particular loan / product category.
obligations.quote: The quantum of penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract without being discriminatory within a particular loan / product category.

obligations.text: The structure of penal charges within a particular loan / product category shall be uniform irrespective of the constitution of the borrower.
obligations.quote: The structure of penal charges within a particular loan / product category shall have to be uniform irrespective of the constitution of the borrower.

obligations.text: The penal charges for loans sanctioned to individual borrowers for purposes other than business shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions.
obligations.quote: The penal charges in case of loans sanctioned to ‘individual borrowers, for purposes other than business’, shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions.

obligations.text: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by the NBFC to customers upfront in the loan agreement and Most Important Terms & Conditions/Key Fact Statement as applicable, in addition to being displayed on the NBFC's website under Interest rates and Service Charges.
obligations.quote: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by the NBFC to the customers upfront in the loan agreement and Most Important Terms & Conditions/ Key Fact Statement as applicable, in addition to being displayed on the NBFC’s website under Interest rates and Service Charges.

obligations.text: Providing only a reference to the schedule of penal charges displayed on the NBFC's website in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice as disclosure.
obligations.quote: Further, providing a reference to the schedule of penal charges displayed on the website of the NBFC in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice.

obligations.text: Whenever reminders for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan are sent to borrowers, the applicable penal charges shall be communicated to them.
obligations.quote: Whenever reminders for non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan are sent to borrowers, the applicable penal charges shall be communicated.

obligations.text: Any instance of levy of penal charges and the reason thereof shall be communicated to the borrower.
obligations.quote: Further, any instance of levy of penal charges and the reason thereof shall also be communicated.

obligations.text: In the case of existing loans, the switchover to the new penal charges regime shall be ensured on the next review or renewal date.
obligations.deadline: next review or renewal date
obligations.quote: In the case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be ensured on next review or renewal date.

obligations.text: At the time of sanction, an NBFC shall clearly communicate to the borrower the possible impact of a change in benchmark interest rate on the loan, leading to changes in EMI and/or tenor or both.
obligations.deadline: At the time of sanction
obligations.quote: At the time of sanction, an NBFC shall clearly communicate to the borrowers about the possible impact of change in benchmark interest rate on the loan leading to changes in EMI and/or tenor or both.

obligations.text: Any increase in the EMI and/or tenor on account of a change in benchmark interest rate shall be communicated to the borrower immediately through appropriate channels.
obligations.quote: Subsequently, any increase in the EMI/ tenor or both on account of the above shall be communicated to the borrower immediately through appropriate channels.

obligations.text: The borrowers shall be given the choice to opt for enhancement in EMI, elongation of tenor, or a combination of both options.
obligations.quote: The borrowers shall also be given the choice to opt for (i) enhancement in EMI or elongation of tenor or for a combination of both options; and, (ii) to prepay, either in part or in full, at any point during the tenor of the loan.

obligations.text: Borrowers shall be given the choice to prepay, either in part or in full, at any point during the tenor of the loan.
obligations.quote: The borrowers shall also be given the choice to opt for (i) enhancement in EMI or elongation of tenor or for a combination of both options; and, (ii) to prepay, either in part or in full, at any point during the tenor of the loan.

obligations.text: Where an entire class of borrowers in a loan category is reset due to an increase in the reference benchmark, the NBFC shall provide the borrowers with the option of enhancement in EMI or elongation of number of EMIs, keeping EMI unchanged, or a combination of both.
obligations.quote: Whenever there is a reset of interest rates for an entire class of borrowers in a particular loan category, say home loan, due to increase in the reference benchmark; the NBFC shall provide the following options to the borrowers

obligations.text: All applicable charges for switching loans from floating to fixed rate and any other service charges/administrative costs incidental to the exercise of the options shall be transparently disclosed in the sanction letter and also at the time of revision of such charges/costs by the NBFC from time to time.
obligations.quote: All applicable charges for switching of loans from floating to fixed rate and any other service charges/ administrative costs incidental to the exercise of the above options shall be transparently disclosed in the sanction letter

obligations.text: The applicable charges shall be as approved by the Board and shall be displayed on the NBFC's website.
obligations.quote: The applicable charges shall be as approved by the Board and shall be displayed on the NBFC’s website.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that the elongation of tenor in case of floating rate loan does not result in negative amortisation.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall ensure that the elongation of tenor in case of floating rate loan does not result in negative amortisation.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall share or make accessible to borrowers, through appropriate channels, a quarterly statement at minimum enumerating principal and interest recovered till date, EMI amount, number of EMIs left and annualized rate of interest/APR for the entire tenor of the loan.
obligations.deadline: at the end of each quarter
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall share / make accessible to the borrowers, through appropriate channels, a statement at the end of each quarter which shall at the minimum, enumerate the principal and interest recovered till date

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that the quarterly statements are simple and easily understood by the borrower.
obligations.deadline: at the end of each quarter
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that the statements are simple and easily understood by the borrower.

obligations.text: In case of loans linked to an external benchmark, the NBFC shall put in place adequate information systems to monitor transmission of changes in the benchmark rate to the lending rate.
obligations.quote: In case of loans linked to an external benchmark, the NBFC shall put in place adequate information systems to monitor transmission of changes in the benchmark rate to the lending rate.

obligations.text: For existing loans sanctioned or renewed on or before December 31, 2025, an NBFC shall not levy pre-payment charges on any floating rate term loan sanctioned for purposes other than business to individual borrowers, with or without co-obligant(s).
obligations.deadline: December 31, 2025
obligations.quote: In case of existing loans sanctioned or renewed on or before December 31, 2025, an NBFC shall not levy pre-payment charges on any floating rate term loan sanctioned for purposes other than business to individual borrowers, with or without co-obligant(s).

obligations.text: For all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), an NBFC shall not levy pre-payment charges.
obligations.deadline: Loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026
obligations.quote: For all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), an NBFC shall not levy pre-payment charges.

obligations.text: An NBFC-Upper Layer shall not levy any pre-payment charges on floating rate loans granted for business purpose to individuals and MSEs, with or without co-obligant(s).
obligations.deadline: Loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026
obligations.quote: an NBFC-Upper Layer shall not levy any pre-payment charges.

obligations.text: An NBFC-Middle Layer shall not levy any pre-payment charges on floating rate business loans to individuals and MSEs with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh.
obligations.deadline: Loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026
obligations.quote: an NBFC-Middle Layer shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/ limit up to ₹50 lakh.

obligations.text: The directions at paragraphs 34(1) and 34(2) apply irrespective of the source of funds used for pre-payment, in part or in full, and without any minimum lock-in period.
obligations.deadline: Loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026
obligations.quote: shall be applicable irrespective of the source of funds used for pre-payment of loans, either in part or in full, and without any minimum lock-in period.

obligations.text: In case of term loans, pre-payment charges, if levied, shall be based on the amount being prepaid.
obligations.deadline: Loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026
obligations.quote: However, in case of term loans, pre-payment charges, if levied by the NBFC, shall be based on the amount being prepaid.

obligations.text: In case of cash credit/overdraft facilities, pre-payment charges on closure before the due date shall be levied on an amount not exceeding the sanctioned limit.
obligations.deadline: Loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026
obligations.quote: In case of cash credit/ overdraft facilities, pre-payment charges on closure of the facility before the due date shall be levied on an amount not exceeding the sanctioned limit.

obligations.text: In case of cash credit/overdraft facilities, no pre-payment charges shall be applicable if the borrower intimates the NBFC of intention not to renew the facility before the period stipulated in the loan agreement, provided the facility gets closed on the due date.
obligations.quote: In case of cash credit/ overdraft facilities, no pre-payment charges shall be applicable if the borrower intimates the NBFC of his/ her/ its intention not to renew the facility before the period as stipulated in the loan agreement

obligations.text: An NBFC shall not levy any charges where pre-payment is effected at the instance of the NBFC.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall not levy any charges where pre-payment is effected at the instance of the NBFC.

obligations.text: The applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and in loans where a Key Facts Statement is required under paragraph 29, also mentioned in the KFS.
obligations.quote: The applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement. Further, in case of loans and advances where Key Facts Statement (KFS) is to be provided

obligations.text: No pre-payment charges which have not been disclosed as specified in the directions shall be charged by the NBFC.
obligations.quote: No pre-payment charges which have not been disclosed as specified herein shall be charged by the NBFC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not levy any charges or fees retrospectively at the time of pre-payment of loans which were waived off earlier by the NBFC.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall not levy any charges / fees retrospectively at the time of pre- payment of loans, which were waived off earlier by the NBFC.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall release all original movable/immovable property documents and remove charges registered with any registry within 30 days after full repayment or settlement of the loan account.
obligations.deadline: within 30 days after full repayment/settlement of the loan account
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall release all the original movable / immovable property documents and remove charges registered with any registry within a period of 30 days after full repayment/ settlement of the loan account.

obligations.text: The timeline and place of return of original movable/immovable property documents shall be mentioned in the loan sanction letters issued on or after December 1, 2023.
obligations.deadline: loan sanction letters issued on or December 1, 2023
obligations.quote: The timeline and place of return of original movable / immovable property documents shall be mentioned in the loan sanction letters issued on or December 1, 2023.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall have a well laid out procedure for return of original movable/immovable property documents to the legal heirs in the event of demise of the sole borrower or joint borrowers.
obligations.quote: an NBFC shall have a well laid out procedure for return of original movable / immovable property documents to the legal heirs.

obligations.text: The procedure for return of property documents to legal heirs shall be displayed on the NBFC's website along with other similar policies and procedures for customer information.
obligations.quote: Such procedure shall be displayed on the website of the NBFC along with other similar policies and procedures for customer information.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall communicate to the borrower reasons for delay in releasing original movable/immovable property documents or failing to file charge satisfaction form with relevant registry beyond 30 days after full repayment/settlement of loan.
obligations.deadline: Beyond 30 days after full repayment/settlement of loan
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall communicate to the borrower reasons for delay in releasing of original movable / immovable property documents or failing to file charge satisfaction form with relevant registry beyond 30 days after full repayment/ settlement of loan.

obligations.text: Where the delay in releasing property documents or filing the charge satisfaction form is attributable to the NBFC, it shall compensate the borrower at the rate of ₹5,000 for each day of delay.
obligations.deadline: Beyond 30 days after full repayment/settlement of loan
obligations.quote: In case where the delay is attributable to the NBFC, it shall compensate the borrower at the rate of ₹5,000 for each day of delay.

obligations.text: In case of loss/damage to original movable/immovable property documents, in part or in full, the NBFC shall assist the borrower in obtaining duplicate/certified copies of the documents.
obligations.quote: In case of loss/damage to original movable / immovable property documents, either in part or in full, an NBFC shall assist the borrower in obtaining duplicate/certified copies of the movable / immovable property documents

obligations.text: In case of loss/damage to original property documents, the NBFC shall bear the associated costs of obtaining duplicate/certified copies, in addition to paying compensation under paragraph 39.
obligations.quote: and shall bear the associated costs, in addition to paying compensation as indicated at paragraph 39 above.

obligations.text: In case of loss/damage to original property documents, the NBFC has an additional 30 days to complete the procedure, with the delayed period penalty calculated thereafter (i.e., after a total period of 60 days).
obligations.deadline: Total period of 60 days
obligations.quote: However, in such cases, an additional time of 30 days will be available to the NBFC to complete this procedure and the delayed period penalty will be calculated thereafter (i.e., after a total period of 60 days).

obligations.text: Instructions issued vide these Directions shall be complied with as expeditiously as possible but no later than April 1, 2026.
obligations.deadline: April 1, 2026
obligations.quote: Instructions issued vide these Directions shall be complied with as expeditiously as possible but no later than April 1, 2026.

obligations.text: The policy on lending against gold and silver collateral (and the SOPs prepared under it) shall cover the conduct-related aspects of the assaying procedure for jewellery, ornaments or coins made of gold or silver, referred to as eligible collateral.
obligations.applies_to: Non-Banking Financial Companies (policy on lending against gold and silver collateral and SOPs under it)
obligations.quote: shall cover the conduct related aspects relating to the assaying procedure of jewellery, ornaments or coins made of gold or silver ("eligible collateral" for this section)

obligations.text: The policy and SOPs on lending against gold and silver collateral shall cover the auction procedure, including the trigger event for auction, the timeline for serving an auction notice on the borrower, the mode of auction, the notice period for settlement before auction, and empanelment of auctioneers.
obligations.applies_to: Non-Banking Financial Companies (policy on lending against gold and silver collateral and SOPs under it)
obligations.quote: the auction procedure specifying, inter alia, the trigger event for the auction of eligible collateral (and timeline for serving an auction notice upon the borrower; mode of auction

obligations.text: An NBFC providing or intending to provide loans against eligible collateral shall ensure that a standardised procedure is put in place to assay the purity of gold and silver collateral and its weight (gross and net).
obligations.applies_to: NBFC providing or intending to provide loans against eligible collateral
obligations.quote: shall ensure that a standardised procedure is put in place to assay the purity of gold and silver collateral, its weight (gross as well as net), etc.

obligations.text: The standardised assaying procedure shall be adopted uniformly across all branches of the NBFC for all assaying procedures, without any deviation.
obligations.applies_to: NBFC providing or intending to provide loans against eligible collateral
obligations.quote: This procedure shall be adopted uniformly across all its branches for all assaying procedures, without any deviation.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall display on its website the methodology adopted for determining the net weight of the gold and silver content of the eligible collateral and the price used to value that content for determining the LTV ratio.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall display on its website the methodology adopted by it for determination of net weight of the gold and silver content of the eligible collateral

obligations.text: An NBFC shall ensure the presence of the borrower(s) while assaying the collateral at the time of sanctioning the loan.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall ensure presence of the borrower(s) while assaying the collateral at the time of sanctioning the loan.

obligations.text: Deductions relating to stone weight, fastenings, etc. as part of the assaying procedure shall be explained to the borrower(s) and the details incorporated in the certificate to be issued.
obligations.quote: The deductions relating to stone weight, fastenings, etc., as part of the assaying procedure shall be explained to the borrower(s) and details incorporated in the certificate to be issued

obligations.text: Post pledging, cases involving loss of gold or silver collateral, or any deterioration or discrepancy in quantity or purity observed during internal audit or otherwise (including at the time of return or auction of collateral), shall be recorded and communicated promptly to the borrower(s)/legal heir(s).
obligations.quote: Post pledging, cases involving loss of gold or silver collateral and any deterioration or discrepancy in quantity or purity observed during internal audit or otherwise including at the time of return or auction of collateral shall be recorded and communicated promptly to the borrower(s)/ legal heir(s).

obligations.text: The process for making reimbursement or compensation as per the policy or SOP shall be communicated to the borrower(s)/legal heir(s).
obligations.quote: The process for making reimbursement or compensation as per the policy or SOP shall also be communicated to the borrower(s)/ legal heir(s).

obligations.text: Documentation shall be standardised across all branches of the NBFC.
obligations.quote: Documentation shall be standardised across all branches of the NBFC.

obligations.text: The loan agreement shall cover the description of the eligible collateral, its value, details of the auction procedure and the circumstances leading to auction, the notice period allowed to the borrower before auction, timelines for release of pledged collateral upon full repayment or settlement, refund of any surplus from auction, and other necessary details.
obligations.quote: The loan agreement shall cover the description of the eligible collateral taken as security, value of such collateral, details of auction procedure and the circumstances leading to the auction of the eligible collateral

obligations.text: All applicable charges payable by the borrower, including those related to assaying and auction, shall be clearly included in the loan agreement and KFS.
obligations.quote: All applicable charges payable by the borrower, including those related to assaying, auction, etc., shall be clearly included in the loan agreement and KFS.

obligations.text: The assay certificate must state the purity (in carats), gross weight of the eligible collateral pledged, net weight of gold or silver content, deductions for stones, lac, alloy, strings and fastenings, any damage, breakage or defects, an image of the collateral, and the collateral value calculated per the RBI Credit Facilities Directions at the time of sanction.
obligations.quote: state therein the purity (in terms of carats); gross weight of the eligible collateral pledged; net weight of gold or silver content therein

obligations.text: One copy of the assay certificate or e-certificate must be kept as part of the loan documents.
obligations.quote: One copy of the certificate or e-certificate shall be kept as part of the loan documents

obligations.text: The other copy of the assay certificate or e-certificate must be given to the borrower under their acknowledgement.
obligations.quote: One copy of the certificate or e-certificate shall be kept as part of the loan documents and the other copy be given to the borrower under their acknowledgement.

obligations.text: All communication with the borrower, especially the terms and conditions of the loan or other important communication affecting the interest of the borrower or the NBFC, shall be in the language of the region or in a language chosen by the borrower.
obligations.quote: All communication with the borrower, especially, the terms and conditions of the loan, or other important communication which affects the interest of the borrower or the NBFC, shall be in the language of the region

obligations.text: For an illiterate borrower, important terms and conditions shall be explained in the presence of a witness who is not an employee of the NBFC.
obligations.quote: For an illiterate borrower, important terms and conditions shall be explained in the presence of a witness, who shall not be an employee of the NBFC.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall ensure that necessary infrastructure and facilities are put in place and appropriate security measures taken in each of its branches where loans are sanctioned against gold or silver collateral.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall ensure that necessary infrastructure and facilities are put in place and appropriate security measures taken in each of its branches where loans are sanctioned against gold or silver collateral.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall ensure that gold and/or silver collateral is handled only in its branches and only by its employees.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall ensure that the gold and/ or silver collateral is handled only in its branches and only by its employees.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall store the collateral only in its branches which are manned by its employees and having safe deposit vaults fit for storing gold and silver.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall store the collateral only in its branches which are manned by its employees and having safe deposit vaults fit for storing gold and silver.

obligations.text: Normally, loans against gold or silver collateral shall not be extended by branches that do not have appropriate secured facility for storage of the pledged eligible collateral.
obligations.quote: Normally, such loans shall not be extended by branches that do not have appropriate secured facility for storage of the pledged eligible collateral.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall periodically review the adequacy of systems for storage of the eligible collateral, conduct training of the concerned staff and carry out internal audit of all procedures to ensure these are strictly adhered to.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall periodically review the adequacy of systems for storage of the eligible collateral, conduct training of the concerned staff and carry out internal audit of all procedures

obligations.text: As part of internal audit, an NBFC shall carry out periodic surprise verification of the gold and silver collateral pledged with it and shall maintain a record thereof.
obligations.quote: As part of internal audit, an NBFC shall carry out periodic surprise verification of the gold and silver collateral pledged with it and shall maintain a record thereof.

obligations.text: A clause shall be included in the loan agreement for obtaining the borrower(s)' consent to carry out surprise verification, including assay of the pledged eligible collateral even in their absence, during the tenor of the loan.
obligations.quote: A clause in the loan agreement shall be included for obtaining consent of the borrower(s) to carry out surprise verification including assay of the pledged eligible collateral even in their absence during the tenor of the loan.

obligations.text: The surprise verification aspect shall be specifically communicated to the borrower at the time of sanctioning the loan.
obligations.deadline: At the time of sanctioning the loan
obligations.quote: This aspect shall be specifically communicated to the borrower at the time of sanctioning the loan.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall release or return the pledged eligible collateral to the borrower(s)/legal heir(s) on the same day, and in any case not exceeding seven working days, upon full repayment or settlement of the loan.
obligations.deadline: Same day, and in any case not exceeding seven working days upon full repayment or settlement of the loan
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall release or return the pledged eligible collateral held as security to the borrower(s)/ legal heir(s) on the same day but in any case, not exceeding a maximum period of seven working days upon full repayment or settlement of the loan.

obligations.text: At the time of release of pledged eligible collateral to the borrower(s)/legal heir(s), the NBFC shall verify the collateral for correctness against the details in the certificate (as per paragraph 50) to the borrowers' satisfaction.
obligations.quote: At the time of release of pledged eligible collateral to the borrower(s)/ legal heir(s), the collateral shall be verified for correctness as per details in the certificate

obligations.text: An NBFC shall give adequate notice to the borrower(s)/legal heir(s), as applicable, through available means of communication to repay or settle the loan dues prior to initiating the auction procedure.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall give adequate notice to the borrower(s)/ legal heir(s), as applicable, through available means of communication to repay or settle the loan dues prior to initiating the auction procedure.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall keep on record a copy of the notice and its acknowledgement in both scenarios.
obligations.quote: A copy of the notice and acknowledgement thereof shall be kept on record in both scenarios.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall implement a transparent auction procedure, which shall include announcement of the auction to the public by issue of advertisements in at least two newspapers, one in the regional language and another in a national daily.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall implement a transparent auction procedure, which shall include, inter alia, announcement of the auction to the public by issue of advertisements in at least two newspapers

obligations.text: The pledged eligible collateral shall be auctioned by an NBFC only through its employee having necessary experience and/or training or an auctioneer empanelled by the NBFC as per its policy.
obligations.quote: The pledged eligible collateral shall be auctioned by an NBFC only through its employee having necessary experience and / or training or an auctioneer empanelled by the NBFC as per its policy.

obligations.text: Where an NBFC conducts auctions through its employees, necessary safeguards such as surprise visits by regional/controlling officials on a periodic basis and coverage under internal audit shall be put in place.
obligations.quote: In cases where auctions are conducted by an NBFC through its employees, necessary safeguards such as surprise visits by regional / controlling officials on periodic basis, coverage under internal audit, etc., shall be put in place.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall declare a reserve price for gold and silver collateral at the time of auction, which shall not be less than 90 per cent of its current value.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall declare a reserve price for the gold and silver collateral at the time of auction, which shall not be less than 90 per cent of its current value.

obligations.text: Where auctions fail twice, the NBFC shall adopt a reserve price not less than 85 per cent of the current value of the gold and silver collateral.
obligations.quote: in case auctions fail twice, a reserve price not less than 85 per cent of its current value shall be adopted.

obligations.text: The first auction of pledged collateral shall be conducted physically in the same district in which the lending branch is located.
obligations.quote: The first auction shall be conducted physically in the same district in which the lending branch is located.

obligations.text: An NBFC or its related parties shall not participate in the auctions of pledged collateral.
obligations.quote: an NBFC or its related parties shall not participate in the auctions to ensure that there is no potential conflict of interest.

obligations.text: After the auction, an NBFC shall mandatorily provide full details of the value fetched at the auction and the dues adjusted to the borrower(s) / legal heir(s).
obligations.deadline: After the auction
obligations.quote: After the auction, an NBFC shall mandatorily provide full details of the value fetched at the auction and the dues adjusted to the borrower(s) / legal heir(s).

obligations.text: The NBFC shall refund any surplus from the auction of gold or silver collateral to the borrower(s) / legal heir(s) within a maximum of seven working days from the date of receipt of the full auction proceeds.
obligations.deadline: Within a maximum period of seven working days from the date of receipt of the full auction proceeds
obligations.quote: The surplus, if any, from the auction of the gold or silver collateral, shall be refunded to the borrower(s) / legal heir(s) within a maximum period of seven working days from the date of receipt of the full auction proceeds.

obligations.text: In case of any damage to the pledged eligible collateral during the tenor of the loan, the NBFC shall bear the cost of repair.
obligations.deadline: During the tenor of loan
obligations.quote: In case of any damage to the pledged eligible collateral by an NBFC during the tenor of loan, the cost of repair shall be borne by the NBFC.

obligations.text: In case of loss of the pledged eligible collateral, or any loss from deterioration or discrepancy in quantity or purity observed during internal audit or otherwise including at return or auction of collateral, the NBFC shall suitably compensate the borrower(s) / legal heir(s).
obligations.quote: In case of loss of the pledged eligible collateral and / or any loss emanating from deterioration or discrepancy in quantity or purity observed during internal audit or otherwise including at the time of return or auction of collateral, an NBFC shall suitably compensate the borrower(s) / legal heir(s).

obligations.text: Where delay in release of pledged collateral after full repayment or settlement of a loan is attributable to the NBFC, the NBFC shall compensate the borrower(s) / legal heir(s) at the rate of ₹5,000 for each day of delay beyond the timeline prescribed at paragraph 58.
obligations.quote: where reasons for delay are attributable to the NBFC, the NBFC shall compensate the borrower(s) / legal heir(s) at the rate of ₹5,000 for each day of delay beyond the timeline prescribed at paragraph 58 above

obligations.text: Where delay in release of pledged collateral is not attributable to the NBFC, the NBFC shall communicate the reasons for such delay to the borrower(s) / legal heir(s).
obligations.quote: If the delay is not attributable to the NBFC, it shall communicate reasons for such delay to the borrower(s) / legal heir(s).

obligations.text: Where the borrower(s) / legal heir(s) has not approached the NBFC for release of pledged eligible collateral after full repayment or settlement of loan, the NBFC shall issue periodic reminders through letters, email or SMS if the email and mobile number are registered with the NBFC.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall issue periodic reminders to borrower(s) / legal heir(s) through letters, email or SMS if the email and mobile number are registered with the NBFC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall periodically undertake special drives to ascertain the whereabouts of the borrower(s) / legal heir(s) in respect of unclaimed gold and/or silver collateral.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall periodically undertake special drives to ascertain the whereabouts of the borrower(s) / legal heir(s) in respect of such unclaimed gold and/ or silver collateral.

obligations.text: A report on unclaimed gold and/or silver collateral shall be put up to the Customer Service Committee or the Board, as the case may be, at half-yearly intervals for a review.
obligations.deadline: half-yearly intervals
obligations.quote: A report on unclaimed gold and /or silver collateral shall be put up to the Customer Service Committee or the Board, as the case may be, at half-yearly intervals for a review.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall refrain from issuing misleading advertisements containing unrealistic claims to promote loans against gold and/or silver collateral.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall refrain from issuance of misleading advertisements containing unrealistic claims to promote loans against gold and/or silver collateral.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall ensure that all arrangements for sourcing and/or recovery of loans against eligible collateral are in compliance with applicable guidelines on outsourcing and recovery practices.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall ensure that all arrangements for sourcing and/ or recovery of loans against eligible collateral, are in compliance with applicable guidelines on outsourcing and recovery practices.

obligations.text: For prudential related aspects and other instructions, the NBFC shall be guided by the instructions contained in the Chapter on 'Lending against Gold and Silver Collateral' in the Credit Facilities Directions, 2025.
obligations.quote: For prudential related aspects and other instructions, the NBFC shall be guided by the instructions contained in the Chapter on ‘Lending against Gold and Silver Collateral’ in Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Credit Facilities) Directions, 2025.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall put in place a Fair Practices Code for microfinance loans, approved by its Board.
obligations.quote: A Fair Practices Code (FPC) for microfinance loans based on these directions shall be put in place by an NBFC with the approval of its Board.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall display the Fair Practices Code in all its offices and on its website.
obligations.quote: The FPC shall be displayed by the NBFC in all its offices and on its website.

obligations.text: The Fair Practices Code should be issued in a language understood by the borrower.
obligations.quote: The FPC should be issued in a language understood by the borrower.

obligations.text: There shall be a standard form of loan agreement for microfinance loans in a language understood by the borrower.
obligations.quote: There shall be a standard form of loan agreement for microfinance loans in a language understood by the borrower.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall provide a loan card to the borrower incorporating the borrower identification information, a simplified pricing factsheet, all other loan terms and conditions, acknowledgement of all repayments and final discharge, and grievance redressal details including the nodal officer's name and contact number.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall provide a loan card to the borrower which shall incorporate the following:

obligations.text: All entries in the loan card shall be in a language understood by the borrower.
obligations.quote: All entries in the loan card shall be in a language understood by the borrower.

obligations.text: Issuance of non-credit products shall be with the full consent of the borrowers.
obligations.quote: Issuance of non-credit products shall be with full consent of the borrowers and fee structure for such products shall be explicitly communicated to the borrower in the loan card itself.

obligations.text: The fee structure for non-credit products shall be explicitly communicated to the borrower in the loan card itself.
obligations.quote: fee structure for such products shall be explicitly communicated to the borrower in the loan card itself.

obligations.text: There shall be no pre-payment charge levied on microfinance loans.
obligations.quote: There shall be no pre-payment charge levied on microfinance loans. Charges, if any, for delayed payment shall be applied on the overdue amount and not on the entire loan amount.

obligations.text: Charges for delayed payment on microfinance loans shall be applied only on the overdue amount and not on the entire loan amount.
obligations.quote: Charges, if any, for delayed payment shall be applied on the overdue amount and not on the entire loan amount.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall prominently display the minimum, maximum and average interest rates charged on microfinance loans in all its offices, in its literature (information booklets/pamphlets) and on its website.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall prominently display the minimum, maximum and average interest rates charged on microfinance loans in all its offices, in the literature (information booklets/ pamphlets) issued by it and details on its website.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall include the minimum, maximum and average interest rates charged on microfinance loans in its supervisory returns, subject to supervisory scrutiny.
obligations.quote: This information shall also be included in the supervisory returns and subjected to supervisory scrutiny.

obligations.text: Any change in interest rate or any other charge shall be informed to the borrower well in advance.
obligations.quote: Any change in interest rate or any other charge shall be informed to the borrower well in advance and these changes shall be effective only prospectively.

obligations.text: Any change in interest rate or any other charge on microfinance loans shall be effective only prospectively.
obligations.quote: these changes shall be effective only prospectively.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall have a board approved policy regarding the conduct of employees and system for their recruitment, training and monitoring.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall have a board approved policy regarding the conduct of employees and system for their recruitment, training and monitoring.

obligations.text: The NBFC's employee conduct policy shall lay down minimum qualifications for the staff and shall provide necessary training tools to deal with the customers.
obligations.quote: This policy shall, inter alia, lay down minimum qualifications for the staff and shall provide necessary training tools to deal with the customers.

obligations.text: Training to employees shall include programs to inculcate appropriate behaviour towards customers.
obligations.quote: Training to employees shall include programs to inculcate appropriate behaviour towards customers.

obligations.text: Conduct of employees towards customers shall be incorporated appropriately in their compensation matrix.
obligations.quote: Conduct of employees towards customers shall also be incorporated appropriately in their compensation matrix.

obligations.text: Field staff shall be trained to make necessary enquiries regarding the income and existing debt of the household.
obligations.quote: Field staff shall be trained to make necessary enquiries regarding the income and existing debt of the household.

obligations.text: Any training offered to borrowers shall be free of cost.
obligations.quote: Training, if any, offered to the borrowers shall be free of cost.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall put in place a mechanism for identification of borrowers facing repayment related difficulties, engagement with such borrowers and providing them necessary guidance about the recourse available.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall put in place a mechanism for identification of the borrowers facing repayment related difficulties, engagement with such borrowers and providing them necessary guidance about the recourse available.

obligations.text: Recovery shall be made at a designated/central designated place decided mutually by the borrower and the NBFC.
obligations.quote: Recovery shall be made at a designated/ central designated place decided mutually by the borrower and the NBFC.

obligations.text: An NBFC or its agent shall not engage in any harsh methods towards recovery.
obligations.quote: An NBFC or its agent shall not engage in any harsh methods towards recovery. Without limiting the general application of the foregoing, following practices shall be deemed as harsh:

obligations.text: An NBFC or its agent shall not use threatening or abusive language towards borrowers in recovery.
obligations.quote: Use of threatening or abusive language

obligations.text: An NBFC or its agent shall not persistently call the borrower and/or call the borrower before 9:00 a.m. and after 6:00 p.m. for recovery.
obligations.quote: Persistently calling the borrower and/ or calling the borrower before 9:00 a.m. and after 6:00 p.m.

obligations.text: An NBFC or its agent shall not harass relatives, friends, or co-workers of the borrower in recovery.
obligations.quote: Harassing relatives, friends, or co-workers of the borrower

obligations.text: An NBFC or its agent shall not publish the name of borrowers in recovery.
obligations.quote: Publishing the name of borrowers

obligations.text: An NBFC or its agent shall not use or threaten violence or similar means to harm the borrower or borrower's family, assets, or reputation.
obligations.quote: Use or threat of use of violence or other similar means to harm the borrower or borrower’s family/ assets/ reputation

obligations.text: An NBFC or its agent shall not mislead the borrower about the extent of the debt or the consequences of non-repayment.
obligations.quote: Misleading the borrower about the extent of the debt or the consequences of non-repayment

obligations.text: An NBFC shall have a dedicated mechanism for redressal of recovery related grievances.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall have a dedicated mechanism for redressal of recovery related grievances. The details of this mechanism shall be provided to the borrower at the time of loan disbursal.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall provide the details of the recovery grievance redressal mechanism to the borrower at the time of loan disbursal.
obligations.deadline: at the time of loan disbursal
obligations.quote: The details of this mechanism shall be provided to the borrower at the time of loan disbursal.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall have a due diligence process in place for engagement of recovery agents, which shall, inter alia, cover individuals involved in the recovery process.
obligations.quote: An NBFC shall have a due diligence process in place for engagement of recovery agents, which shall, inter alia, cover individuals involved in the recovery process.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall ensure that the recovery agents engaged by it carry out verification of the antecedents of its employees, which shall include police verification.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that the recovery agents engaged by them carry out verification of the antecedents of its employees, which shall include police verification.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall decide the periodicity at which re-verification of antecedents of recovery agents' employees shall be resorted to.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall also decide the periodicity at which re-verification of antecedents shall be resorted to.

obligations.text: An NBFC shall provide the details of recovery agents to the borrower while initiating the process of recovery.
obligations.quote: an NBFC shall provide the details of recovery agents to the borrower while initiating the process of recovery.

obligations.text: A recovery agent shall carry a copy of the notice and the authorisation letter from the NBFC along with the identity card issued to him/her by the NBFC or the agency.
obligations.quote: The agent shall also carry a copy of the notice and the authorisation letter from the NBFC along with the identity card issued to him/her by the NBFC or the agency.

obligations.text: Where the recovery agency is changed during the recovery process, the NBFC shall notify the borrower of the change.
obligations.quote: where the recovery agency is changed by the NBFC during the recovery process, in addition to the NBFC notifying the borrower of the change

obligations.text: A new recovery agent, on change of recovery agency during the recovery process, shall carry the notice and the authorisation letter along with his/her identity card.
obligations.quote: the new agent shall carry the notice and the authorisation letter along with his/her identity card.

obligations.text: The notice and the authorisation letter shall, among other details, also include the contact details of the recovery agency and the NBFC.
obligations.quote: The notice and the authorisation letter shall, among other details, also include the contact details of the recovery agency and the NBFC.

obligations.text: The up-to-date details of the recovery agencies engaged by the NBFC shall also be hosted on the NBFC's website.
obligations.quote: The up-to-date details of the recovery agencies engaged by the NBFC shall also be hosted on the NBFC’s website.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that the DSA / DMA / Recovery Agents are properly trained to handle their responsibilities with care and sensitivity, including soliciting customers, hours of calling, privacy of customer information and conveying correct terms and conditions of products.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that the DSA / DMA / Recovery Agents are properly trained to handle their responsibilities with care and sensitivity, particularly aspects such as soliciting customers, hours of calling, privacy of customer information

obligations.text: The NBFC shall obtain the undertaking of DSA / DMA / Recovery Agents to abide by the code of conduct.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall obtain the undertaking of DSA / DMA / Recovery Agents to abide by the code of conduct.

obligations.text: Recovery Agents shall adhere to extant instructions on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs as also the NBFC's own code for collection of dues and repossession of security.
obligations.quote: In addition, Recovery Agents shall adhere to extant instructions on Fair Practices Code for NBFCs as also its own code for collection of dues and repossession of security.

ratings.policy_quote: The Board reviews compliance with this code every year.
ratings.finding: The policy has Board review of the Fair Practices Code every year and annual review of all policies, which supports Board-approved policies and review mechanisms for responsible business conduct.

ratings.policy_quote: Loan application screens are in English and Hindi.
ratings.finding: The policy makes application screens available in English and Hindi, but it does not say the Fair Practices Code itself is provided in the vernacular or in a language the borrower understands.
ratings.action: Add to FC-14 that the Fair Practices Code is provided in the vernacular or in a language the borrower understands, and not only the application screens.

ratings.finding: No paragraph requires disputes arising from decisions of functionaries to be heard and disposed of at least at the next higher level; the grievance policy only covers nodal officers and quarterly review.

ratings.policy_quote: Any change to charges is told to borrowers at least 30 days in advance, by SMS and in the app.
ratings.finding: The policy requires 30 days' advance notice of charge changes, but it does not require the Fair Practices Code's transparency guidelines to be considered when setting interest rates and processing, penal and other charges.
ratings.action: Add a clause to FC-14 requiring that interest rates and processing, penal and other charges be set in line with the Code's transparency guidelines on loan terms.

ratings.policy_quote: The Board reviews compliance with this code every year.
ratings.finding: FC-14 requires the Board to review Fair Practices Code compliance annually, but no paragraph has the Board review the functioning of the grievance redressal mechanism at various management levels; FP-09 assigns grievance review to the Customer Service Committee, not the Board.
ratings.action: Amend FC-14 §7.1 so the Board's periodic review also covers the functioning of the grievance redressal mechanism at each level of management, not only Fair Practices Code compliance.

ratings.policy_quote: The Customer Service Committee reviews complaint volumes, root causes and turnaround times every quarter.
ratings.finding: FP-09 has the Customer Service Committee review grievances quarterly and FC-14 has the Board review compliance annually, but neither requires a consolidated report of these reviews to be submitted to the Board at regular intervals.
ratings.action: Add a requirement that the Customer Service Committee's quarterly grievance reviews and the annual Fair Practices Code review are consolidated into a report submitted to the Board at regular intervals.

ratings.policy_quote: Loan application screens are in English and Hindi.
ratings.finding: The policy makes application screens available in English and Hindi, but does not require all borrower communications to be in a vernacular language or one the borrower understands.
ratings.action: Extend the policy so that all borrower communications are in the borrower's vernacular language or a language the borrower understands, not only application screens in English and Hindi.

ratings.policy_quote: A Key Fact Statement (KFS), in the standard format, is shown before the loan agreement is signed.
ratings.finding: The KFS shows the APR, but it is shown only before the agreement is signed, and no policy paragraph requires the application form itself to carry the information needed for comparison with other lenders.
ratings.action: Require the loan application form to show the APR and other terms affecting the borrower so that a meaningful comparison with other lenders is possible, not only the KFS shown before signing.

ratings.finding: No policy paragraph states which documents must be submitted with the loan application form.
No policy paragraph requires an acknowledgement for receipt of loan applications; the only timing rule covers telling applicants whether the loan is sanctioned.

ratings.policy_quote: Applicants are told within 2 working days whether the loan is sanctioned.
ratings.finding: FC-14 §1.1 provides English and Hindi application screens, a sanction notice within 2 working days and written reasons for rejection, but nothing requires a written sanction letter stating the sanctioned amount, the full terms and the annualised rate of interest in the borrower's understood language.
ratings.action: Add to FC-14 §1.1 a requirement that every sanction is conveyed in writing, in the borrower's understood vernacular language, stating the sanctioned amount, all terms and the annualised interest rate and its method of application.

ratings.finding: No paragraph shown requires FlexiCredit to record and keep the borrower's acceptance of the loan terms and conditions.

ratings.policy_quote: If an EMI is not paid on its due date, **penal interest** of 2% a month is added to the loan's interest rate on the overdue amount until it is paid.
ratings.finding: FC-14 §3.1 sets the late-payment penal interest of 2% a month, but does not require the penalty to be shown in bold in the loan agreement.
ratings.action: Amend FC-14 §3.1 and the loan agreement template so that the late-repayment penalty is printed in bold in the loan agreement.

ratings.finding: No paragraph requires FlexiCredit to furnish borrowers a copy of the loan agreement as understood by the borrower, or of each enclosure quoted in it, at sanction or disbursement; FC-14 §1.1 covers only the sanction notice and reasons for rejection.

ratings.policy_quote: Any change to charges is told to borrowers at least 30 days in advance, by SMS and in the app.
ratings.finding: FC-14 §4.1 requires advance notice of charge changes by SMS and in the app, but does not cover changes to interest rates, disbursement schedule or prepayment charges, and does not require notice in the vernacular or a language the borrower understands.
ratings.action: Extend the advance notice to all changes in terms, including interest rates, disbursement schedule, service charges and prepayment charges, and give it in the vernacular or a language the borrower understands.

ratings.policy_quote: Interest rates are fixed for the life of the loan and set by the Board-approved interest rate model
ratings.finding: FC-14 §2.1 fixes interest rates for the life of the loan, which leaves no mid-loan rate change, but FC-14 §4.1 allows charge changes on 30 days' notice without stating that they take effect only prospectively.
ratings.action: State in FC-14 §4.1 that any change to interest rates or charges takes effect only prospectively, for loans sanctioned or disbursed after the change, and never for existing loans.

ratings.finding: No paragraph shows that the loan agreement must contain a condition limiting interest rate and charge changes to prospective effect.

ratings.policy_quote: Borrowers are not harassed at any time.

ratings.action: Amend FC-13 §3.1 to require an APR computation sheet and the full amortisation schedule over the loan tenor, with APR computed on all charges levied by FlexiCredit.

ratings.policy_quote: Borrowers are not harassed at any time.
ratings.finding: The policy bars harassment at any time but does not explicitly prohibit harsh methods of recovery, so the rule's wider prohibition is only partly covered.
ratings.action: Add an explicit prohibition on harsh methods of recovery to FC-17 §3.2 or FC-14 §5.1.

ratings.policy_quote: Agents may not use threats, abusive language, or contact the borrower's family, friends or colleagues.
ratings.finding: FC-17 §3.2 prohibits agents from using threats and abusive language, which matches the rule.

ratings.policy_quote: Calls and visits are allowed between 8 am and 9 pm.
ratings.finding: The policy permits recovery calls from 8 am to 9 pm, whereas the rule prohibits calls before 9:00 a.m. and after 6:00 p.m. and prohibits persistent calls, which the policy does not address.
ratings.action: Change FC-17 §3.1 so recovery calls are allowed only between 9:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. and add a prohibition on persistent calls.
